title: Concept: absent X-Frame-Options
description: No X-Frame-Options means the response can be placed in a frame by any site, which enables clickjacking: an invisible frame puts real controls under attacker-chosen text. Current browsers also honour CSP frame-ancestors, which is the preferred control.
applicability: HTML responses that a browser may render inside a frame.
risk: Clickjacking of authenticated UI; MEDIUM severity.
